### Deferred

- local_gateway.go / secondary_net.go / vpn_concentrator.go / vpc_config.go(exclusions) / ip_pools.go / capacity_family.go / declarative_policies.go / host_reservations.go / mac_hosts.go / sql_ha.go / trunk_enclave.go: these "batch4/5" resource structs embed their own `Tags map[string]string` field (set from the create-call's tags param) IN ADDITION TO participating in the shared b.tags map via CreateTags/DescribeTags. The two are never synchronized — CreateTags after creation only writes b.tags, so DescribeXxx handlers reading the embedded field will miss tags added post-creation. Full fix requires auditing every describe/wire-shape path per family to pick one source of truth (recommend: drop the embedded field, always read via TagsForResource). Found while doing the tag-cleanup sweep above; out of scope for this pass (touches wire shapes in ~10 more files).
